question: How do time-mixed training and conventional random row splits change measured attack-stage recognition?
anchor: Within each original later capture and author class, sort observable event SHA256 and retain the first ceiling-half. Identical anchor for both primary training arms and every seed/view.
past_pool: Original fitting captures only, excluding all current-feature fingerprints found in the common anchor.
mixed_pool: Original fitting and non-anchor later-test rows, excluding original calibration and every current-feature fingerprint found in the common anchor. Allows future training deliberately as a diagnostic, not deployment-valid evaluation.
training_counts: Per class minimum of past and mixed eligible support and caps [20000,5000,5000,5000]; same counts for all arms. Deterministic seeded hash sample without replacement.
conventional_random: Seeded stratified 55 percent test from all prepared rows; remaining rows form training pool, sampled to the same class counts. No calibration or threshold selection. This secondary comparison changes the test population; its difference is not a pure temporal-leakage estimate.
predictors: Qualified current-flow features, optionally prior-only history. No absolute time, host identity, capture identity or target in model inputs. No preprocessing fit on test.
metrics: All four class F1/precision/recall/AP/ROC-AUC, macro-F1, normal false attack count/rate, any-attack movement recall, exact-fingerprint overlaps and temporal ordering diagnostics.
uncertainty: Primary paired capture bootstrap over common-anchor captures, 1000 draws per seed/view. Only five later captures from one campaign; descriptive conditional intervals, not independent-campaign uncertainty. Report individual seed outcomes and mean; seeds are not independent datasets.
decision: Report directions and effect sizes with limitations, not an arbitrary pass magnitude. Positive time-mixed-minus-past score is protocol sensitivity on these data, not proof that every published result is inflated; null is not certification.
scope: Previously exposed UNRAVELED single campaign, author-stage labels, full current flows. No early warning, proof of successful lateral movement/theft, or claim of first APT temporal evaluation.
